_about: Skill trees on Durango's 1-60 scale (specs 03/09/11/12 + systems PRD §7). Every tree starts at Lv. 1; auto nodes are learned free once their level is reached. status: functional = the game enforces the effect, partial = the value exists but no system reads it yet, defined = data only. source: spec09/11/12 = Durango pack, prd7 = our PRD. sp_assumed / level_assumed = the pack gives no SP / level, ours is a placeholder. A tree level cannot exceed the character level except levels granted by the occupation (ASSUMPTION). impl = functional / partial / defined: does a code path read this node's effect today (functional), some of it (partial) or none (defined)? impl_ref = the first script and line that reads it; empty (missing) for defined nodes. Written by the skilltrees job; specs 03/09/11/12.

reference._about: Spec 12: the 918 original technique records (Durango:0 docs). The source table (kghj76138.github.io/durango-homecoming-guide/en/skills.html) returned 404 on 2026-10-20, so only nodes the pack names are real nodes; the remainder of each category's count is imported as per-tree 'catalog' rows (named ones from spec 12, the rest as <tree>_unspecified_N placeholders with source spec12_count_only). Every catalog row carries impl; catalog rows do not participate in SP, saves or SkillState.ORDER.

named_only._about: Spec 12:162 names Surviving Durango I-VII as Survival category milestones but gives no level, SP or effect, so they are recorded here and not placed in the tree. Spec 12:115 also mentions an instrument-making line with no node names.

toxic_oil_islands._about: Spec 12 §9: the 13th (late-game, optional) category; 18 nodes, 0 SP. Names from trees.json reference.toxic_oil_islands.unlocks; the rest are count-only placeholders. Kept outside SkillState.ORDER so the runtime twelve-tree system is untouched until a toxic-oil biome exists (ASSUMPTION).
